overall_summary: No true sensor closed loop (policy re-observing its own new camera view after moving) exists or can be built on this server. The only closed-loop-like evaluations that are possible for this camera-only checkpoint are (b) NAVSIM v2 two-stage pseudo-simulation (code + checkpoint present and already run in Exp 25/26; re-running it now is blocked by disk because the synthetic images were deleted) and the existing log-observation receding-horizon pseudo closed loop (Exp 13, cameras from the log). (a) nuPlan closed-loop has no camera rendering and no nuPlan DBs/configs; (c) CARLA/Bench2Drive has no simulator, no renderer libraries and no CARLA checkpoint.

b_navsim_v2_pseudo_simulation.what_it_is: two-stage aggregation: stage 1 = original scene, 4 s plan; stage 2 = pre-rendered synthetic follow-up scenes from PRE-COMPUTED perturbed start states, Gaussian-weighted by proximity to the policy's stage-1 endpoint (navsim_v2/docs/metrics.md 'Pseudo Closed-Loop Aggregation'). The policy does NOT re-observe a rendering of its own endpoint; each call is still a single independent plan.

minimal_next_steps.what: True sensor closed loop: requires (i) a host with NVIDIA EGL/Vulkan exposed, (ii) CARLA 0.9.15 + Bench2Drive (~20-25 GB + per-route logs), and (iii) an AutoVLA model trained on CARLA data (author release or own SFT/RFT of the 3B model on Bench2Drive, tens of GPU-days). Alternatively a neural-rendering (3DGS) closed-loop simulator on nuPlan logs that renders the nuPlan camera rig at arbitrary ego poses - none is present here and none was verified for AutoVLA.
